title: lycium scoparium var. argentinum
intro: Lycium scoparium var. argentinum, commonly known as Argentine wolfberry, is a variant of the Lycium scoparium plant species, which belongs to the nightshade family (Solanaceae). This plant is valued for its rich nutritional profile and is used to support various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Argentine wolfberry include promoting skin health, improving vision, and supporting immune function, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids. The bioactive constituents of Argentine wolfberry are responsible for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine and nutritional supplements.
